views.name: wyoming_city_population_median_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  city.city_name AS city_name,
  city.population AS population,
  city.state_name AS state_name,
  (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN CAST(val_mid AS REAL)
        ELSE (val_low + val_high) / 2.0
      END
    FROM (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((cnt+1)/2) THEN population END) AS val_mid,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (cnt/2) THEN population END) AS val_low,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (cnt/2 + 1) THEN population END) AS val_high
      FROM (
        SELECT population,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY population) AS rn
        FROM city AS c2
        WHERE c2.state_name = city.state_name
      ) numbered
      CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM city AS c3 WHERE c3.state_name = city.state_name)
    )
  ) AS state_city_population_median,
  CASE
    WHEN city.population > (
      SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN CAST(val_mid AS REAL)
          ELSE (val_low + val_high) / 2.0
        END
      FROM (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS cnt,
          MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((cnt+1)/2) THEN population END) AS val_mid,
          MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (cnt/2) THEN population END) AS val_low,
          MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (cnt/2 + 1) THEN population END) AS val_high
        FROM (
          SELECT population,
                 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY population) AS rn
          FROM city AS c4
          WHERE c4.state_name = city.state_name
        ) numbered2
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM city AS c5 WHERE c5.state_name = city.state_name)
      )
    ) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_above_state_median
FROM city
views.description: Per-city population with median population for that city's state (computed per state). Adds a flag/classification whether the city's population is strictly above the state's city-median. Grain is one row per city.

views.name: state_canonical_measures
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.state_name AS state_name,
  CAST(s.population AS INTEGER) AS population,
  CAST(s.area AS REAL) AS area,
  CASE
    WHEN s.density IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(s.density AS REAL)
    WHEN s.population IS NOT NULL AND s.area IS NOT NULL AND s.area != 0 THEN CAST(s.population AS REAL) / CAST(s.area AS REAL)
    WHEN s.population IS NOT NULL AND s.area IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE NULL
  END AS density
FROM state_basic s

semantic_filters.population: NULLs kept (normalization only); consumer may filter required non-null later

views.description: Canonicalized numeric measures for each state. Ensures population and area are cast to numeric types and provides a computed density value (population/area) even if the density column is NULL or inconsistent.
